# Northstar Pricing Policy 2027

## 1. Purpose

Sets discount approval authority for direct enterprise sales for calendar 2027.

Yes. The decision on DR-9001 was valid under the rules in force when it was made.

**The decision (DEC-2026-0001)**
- **Request:** Sarah Chen, an Enterprise Account Executive, asked on 2026-09-23 for a 15% discount for Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048 / ERP C-1001) on the NS-500 Industrial Controller.
- **Outcome:** Approved with authorization. Michael Torres, VP Sales, approved it on 2026-09-24.
- **Was the customer eligible for 15%?** Yes. The Master Supply Agreement ACME-MFG-2025 §3.2 and pricing exception EXC-ACME-NS500-15 allow up to 15% on the NS-500 only, from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31. That covers the request date. An older 2023 exception at 10% had already been replaced by this one.

**Rules in force at the time: Northstar Pricing Policy 2026 and Approval Authority Matrix APP-MATRIX-2026, effective 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31**
- Account Executives can approve discounts up to 10%, so Sarah Chen could not approve 15% herself.
- Discounts above 10% and up to 20% need VP Sales approval.
- Michael Torres was listed as VP Sales in the employee list and the org chart. He approved the request, so the right role signed off.

**Rules have changed since, but that doesn't affect this decision**
- The 2027 Pricing Policy took effect on 2027-01-01. Under it, any discount above 12% needs the Chief Revenue Officer, so the same 15% request would need David Morgan today.
- That policy only covers requests dated on or after 2027-01-01, so it doesn't apply to DR-9001.

**One limitation:** the records showing Torres as VP Sales have no dates. They reflect the current org records rather than a dated history.
